days.text: Baseline assessment (D0): optic nerve sheath of 4.84 mm on ultrasound. Reaction time (PVT) of 262 ms. Status: nominal.
Optic nerve sheath at 5.16 mm, rising: fluids shift toward the head in microgravity. Stable alertness (PVT 269 ms). Status: nominal.
Optic nerve sheath at 5.33 mm: the rise is slowing. Stable alertness (PVT 269 ms). Status: nominal.

Optic nerve sheath at 5.65 mm, rising over 7 days: status: monitor. It is an indirect marker of intracranial pressure, linked to in-flight vision changes (SANS). Suggested action: vision test and repeat measurement, to be sent to the ground flight surgeon.
The model does not project the eye beyond today. Last measurement (D94): optic nerve sheath at 5.65 mm, to monitor. Ultrasound follow-up continues until Sol 0.
